# smalldi

> Annotation-driven dependency injection for Python: classes are registered as singletons or interfaces with `Injector` decorators, functions decorated with `@Injector.inject` receive instances for parameters annotated `Provide[T]`, and `with Injector.context(kind):` scopes registrations, overrides and instances to a block; the module-level shorthands `singleton`, `interface`, `implements`, `override`, `inject`, `issingleton` and `isinterface` delegate to the `Injector` methods. Requires Python >=3.11, has zero runtime dependencies, MIT license.

smalldi is a small library with a single static registry, `Injector`. `@Injector.singleton` registers a class, `@Injector.interface` registers an abstract class, `@Injector.implements(Interface)` and `@Injector.override(Target)` bind singletons to interfaces or to other singletons, and `@Injector.inject` fills `Provide[T]` parameters. `Injector.get_instance(T)` returns the instance for a registered singleton or interface. `smalldi` also exports the module-level shorthands `singleton`, `interface`, `implements`, `override` and `inject` for `Injector.singleton`, `Injector.interface`, `Injector.implements`, `Injector.override` and `Injector.inject`, and `issingleton` and `isinterface` for `Injector.is_singleton` and `Injector.is_interface`; they act on the current context and are all in `smalldi.__all__`. The package ships type information (`py.typed`).

Singletons are lazy: `@Injector.singleton` does not instantiate the class. The instance is created the first time it is requested, at most once per class, and the constructor must take no arguments or be decorated with `@Injector.inject`. Registering the same class twice raises `TypeError`; a reloaded module defines new class objects that are registered as additional singletons, so module reloading is not supported.

Interfaces: an interface is an `abc.ABC` subclass with at least one abstract method, registered with `@Injector.interface`. Exactly one singleton may be declared as its implementation with `@Injector.implements(Interface)`, applied above `@Injector.singleton`; the class must be a subclass of the interface. `Provide[Interface]` injects the implementation's instance, the same object `Provide[Implementation]` receives. A second implementation raises `RuntimeError`; calling an injected function while the interface has neither an implementation nor an override raises `RuntimeError`.

Overrides: `@Injector.override(Target, when=lambda: ...)`, applied above `@Injector.singleton`, makes the decorated singleton the instance injected for `Target` only when `when()` returns `True`; `when` is called once, when the decorator is applied (at import time), and when it returns `False`, the decorator is a no-op and leaves bindings unchanged. `Target` is a registered singleton or interface. The target's class, or the interface's implementation, is never instantiated through the injector, and an interface override wins whatever the order of declaration. When enabled, the override must be a registered singleton and a subclass of the target, and a class cannot override itself. Overrides are a single delegation hop and are not transitive: an override cannot be overridden, an overridden singleton cannot become an override, and both raise `TypeError`. Each target has at most one override; a second one raises `RuntimeError` for a singleton target and `TypeError` for an interface target. An interface whose implementation is overridden resolves to the implementation's override. Validation happens before anything is bound.

Freezing: a singleton or interface is frozen the first time an instance is requested through it, even if the constructor raised or the interface had no binding. Overriding a frozen target raises `SingletonFrozenError`, importable from `smalldi`. A frozen interface still accepts a first implementation if it already has an override. A singleton target may be overridden by a class that was already injected, and then shares its instance; if that class was requested but has no instance (its constructor is running or raised), the override raises `SingletonFrozenError`. Reading the deprecated `Injector.singletons_available` instantiates and freezes every registered singleton.

`@Injector.inject` checks at decoration time that every `Provide[T]` names a registered singleton or interface (`TypeError` otherwise) and resolves the instances at every call, in the context current at that call, so overrides declared after decoration but before the first call are respected, and an interface needs a binding only by the time the function is called. A keyword argument passed by the caller replaces the injected value. On an `async def` function, `@Injector.inject` returns a coroutine function that resolves `Provide[T]` when the coroutine starts running, not when the function is called.

Contexts: an `InjectionContext` is one registry of singletons and one of interfaces. `with Injector.context(kind):` makes a child context current for the block; `kind` is a member of `smalldi.context.InjectionSubcontextType`, `RESET` by default, or a `smalldi.context.InjectionContextOverride` subclass or instance, described below. `PRESERVE` pushes the same `InjectionContext` object as the current one. `RESET` keeps the same registrations, implementations and overrides but gives every singleton a fresh, unfrozen `LazySingleton` without an instance; classes sharing one singleton through an override keep sharing one, and interfaces are rebound to the new singletons. `EMPTY` has nothing registered. `SHALLOW` is a new registry dict holding the same `LazySingleton` objects, so instances and frozen state are shared with the parent; singletons registered inside are invisible to the parent, but overriding an inherited singleton inside mutates the shared object and is visible in the parent. `STACK` makes each singleton's effective class (its override if any, else its own class) the base of a fresh singleton with no override, keeps classes that shared one singleton sharing one, and turns an interface's override into its implementation so it can be overridden again. `Injector.context(kind)` and `Injector.foreign_context(ctx)` return a single-use context manager: nothing is pushed until `__enter__`, the child is built from the context current at `__enter__` time, `__enter__` returns the `InjectionContext`, `__exit__` pops exactly the context the manager pushed, exiting out of order raises `RuntimeError` and leaves the stack unchanged, and entering the same manager twice raises `RuntimeError`. `Injector.get_context()` returns the current context. A registration goes into the context current when the decorator runs; Python caches modules, so a module first imported inside `with Injector.context(...)` keeps its registrations in that context only: import modules at the root. A request for an instance freezes what it looks up in the current context; a `RESET` or `STACK` child starts unfrozen. `smalldi.context.InjectionContextOverride` declares a `SHALLOW` child, a declared context, as a dataclass: `Injector.context(Fixture)` takes the fields' defaults as the values, `Injector.context(Fixture(...))` the instance's attributes, where None presets nothing, and `Fixture.apply(context)` derives the child of a given context without pushing it; a field `n: T` gives the child a singleton of its own for `T` (a clone of a registered `T`'s singleton, so instances and overrides inside the block stay inside; a registration in the child only for an unregistered `T`), and `n: T = instance` sets `instance` on that singleton and freezes it, unseen by the parent. `T` is a concrete class. A field `n: ImplementationOf[I]`, with `ImplementationOf` imported from `smalldi` and `I` an abstract class, gives the child a binding of its own for the interface `I`: without a value the binding has neither implementation nor override, whatever the parent has, so the block binds it with `@Injector.implements(I)` or `@Injector.override(I)` before requesting `I` (a request before that raises `RuntimeError` and freezes the child's binding), and an `I` the parent doesn't know is registered in the child only; `n: ImplementationOf[I] = instance` binds `instance` as the frozen implementation of `I`, so `Provide[I]` is `instance` in the block and the binding accepts no override; the instance is held by a singleton of the binding alone, so `type(instance)` is not registered, `Provide[type(instance)]` resolves as in the parent, and several interface fields may hold instances of one class or one object; `instance` must be an instance of `I` (a mock with `spec=I` is one), else `TypeError` when the context manager is created. `ImplementationOf[I] | None`, `Optional[ImplementationOf[I]]` and `ImplementationOf[I | None]` all declare `I`. The parent's binding for `I` is never changed, and the parent's other interfaces stay bound in the child, to the clones where their singletons are declared. Overriding the block's `I` with an inherited, undeclared singleton marks that shared object, and a request through the binding freezes it, as in any `SHALLOW` child. A plain abstract class as a field, `ImplementationOf[C]` with a concrete `C` and `Provide[T]` raise `TypeError` when the context manager is created; two concrete fields resolving to one singleton raise `TypeError` at `__enter__`, and nothing is pushed. The parent is never changed. `smalldi.context.InjectionContextSingletonOverride` and `smalldi.InjectionContextSingletonOverride` are the deprecated aliases of `InjectionContextOverride`: the same class, whose import or attribute access warns with `DeprecationWarning`.

Execution slices: contexts are tracked per execution slice, the running `asyncio.Task` if code runs inside a Task, otherwise the current `threading.Thread` object. A slice with nothing pushed sees the root context. A native `threading.Thread` starts in the root context regardless of the context of the thread that created it; `smalldi.thread.ContextAwareThread` captures the creator's current `InjectionContext` in `__init__` (by reference, not a copy) and enters it for the duration of `run()`. An `asyncio.Task` starts in the root context; opening injection contexts inside coroutines is not supported. If a slice ends with contexts still open, they are removed and a `ResourceWarning` is emitted.

Threads: the injector may be used from several threads. Each singleton is constructed at most once per context; other threads requesting the same instance wait for the constructor. No lock guarding the registry or a binding is held while a constructor runs. One `InjectionContext` may be current for several threads (`PRESERVE`, `SHALLOW`, `ContextAwareThread`), which is safe because every access goes through `Injector` under its class mutex. A binding racing the first injection of its target either wins or is refused with `SingletonFrozenError`. Circular dependencies within one thread raise `RuntimeError`. Known limitation: a dependency cycle spanning several threads, or a constructor waiting for another thread that needs the singleton being constructed, is not detected and may deadlock.

Also included: `Container`, a singleton base class that collects classes and functions registered with `@MyContainer.component`; `Collector.collect_from_package`, which imports every module of a package so decorators run; `smalldi.concurrency` with the `@synchronized` and `@threadsafe` lock decorators; and `smalldi.decorator.oneshot` with `OneshotLevel`, which runs a function once per level and returns the first result afterwards: `GLOBAL` (once everywhere, the level of the bare `@oneshot` and of `@oneshot()`), `PER_CLASS` (once per class, the `cls` of a classmethod or `type(self)` of an instance method) or `PER_INSTANCE` (once per instance, instance methods only); on a classmethod or a staticmethod `@oneshot` goes above `@classmethod` / `@staticmethod`, a call that raises stores nothing, a re-entrant call for the same key raises `RuntimeError`, and concurrent first calls run the function once.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md): singletons, containers, interfaces and contexts, each with an example followed by its rules
- [Singletons](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#singletons): lazy instantiation, exactly once, and the module reload warning
- [Injector.singletons_available (deprecated)](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#injectorsingletons_available-deprecated): the deprecated snapshot and what reading it does
- [Interfaces](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#interfaces): `@Injector.interface`, `@Injector.implements` and `Provide[Interface]`
- [Overrides](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#overrides): `@Injector.override` for singletons and interfaces, the non-transitivity rules
- [Overrides: freezing](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#overrides): what freezes a target and `SingletonFrozenError`, in the Overrides rules
- [How singletons work](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#how-singletons-work): exactly-once construction across threads, circular dependencies and the undetected deadlock cases
- [Contexts](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#contexts): `Injector.context(kind)`, the five context kinds, per-slice tracking, `ContextAwareThread` and the import caveat
- [Declared contexts](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#declared-contexts): `InjectionContextOverride`, the dataclass declaring a `SHALLOW` child with singletons and `ImplementationOf[I]` interface bindings of its own, the class and instance forms, presets and the refusals
- [docs/index.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/index.md): index of the documentation pages
- [docs/features/index.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/features/index.md): one page per feature, what it gives and when to reach for it
- [docs/features/singletons.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/features/singletons.md): singletons in short: lazy construction, `Provide[T]`, `Injector.get_instance`, freezing, with a runnable example
- [docs/features/interfaces.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/features/interfaces.md): interfaces and overrides in short: `@Injector.interface`, `@Injector.implements`, `@Injector.override` with `when=`, one override per target, `SingletonFrozenError`
- [docs/features/contexts.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/features/contexts.md): contexts in short: `with Injector.context()`, the five kinds and when to use each, declared contexts, execution slices
- [docs/features/containers.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/features/containers.md): containers in short: `@MyContainer.component`, metadata, `_get_components`, `_on_component_register`, freezing on the first component
- [docs/features/utilities.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/features/utilities.md): `@synchronized`, `@threadsafe`, `@oneshot` and `Collector` in short, with runnable examples
- [docs/use-cases/index.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/use-cases/index.md): the use cases, each mapped to the features it builds on
- [docs/use-cases/wiring-an-application.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/use-cases/wiring-an-application.md): a complete program wired with singletons, construction on demand, the injected entry point, async entry points
- [docs/use-cases/swapping-implementations.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/use-cases/swapping-implementations.md): choosing a backend per environment with `when=`, extending a singleton you don't own, getting the declaration order right
- [docs/use-cases/testing.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/use-cases/testing.md): a `RESET` context per test, fakes by override, mocks through declared contexts, the pytest autouse fixture, which tool when
- [docs/use-cases/plugins.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/use-cases/plugins.md): a container filled by plugin modules that `Collector.collect_from_package` imports, with a runnable package
- [docs/use-cases/threads-and-async.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/use-cases/threads-and-async.md): exactly-once construction across threads, `ContextAwareThread`, `@threadsafe` on a singleton's state, `@Injector.inject` on `async def`
- [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/architecture.md): entity diagram of the injector's objects, what `Injector.get_instance` and `@Injector.override` do step by step
- [docs/contexts.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/contexts.md): each context kind with a before/after diagram, context trees per thread and task, stack unwinding, the import caveat and the coroutine limitation
- [docs/migration/index.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/migration/index.md): which migration guide to follow when upgrading from 0.2 or 0.3, and why 0.4 to 0.5 and 0.5.0 to 0.5.1 need none
- [docs/migration/0.2-to-0.3.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/migration/0.2-to-0.3.md): 0.2 to 0.3: lazy singletons, the deprecated `Injector.singletons_available`, single registration, `typing-extensions`, with search patterns, before/after snippets and a checklist
- [docs/migration/0.3-to-0.4.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/migration/0.3-to-0.4.md): 0.3 to 0.4: `Provide[T]` resolved when a coroutine starts, override refusals, contexts replacing registry-clearing fixtures, with search patterns, before/after snippets and a checklist
- [docs/migration/0.2-to-0.4.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/migration/0.2-to-0.4.md): the direct path from 0.2 to 0.4, with search patterns, before/after snippets and a checklist
- [docs/concurrency.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/concurrency.md): the locks, freeze-on-lookup, override refusals, detected and undetected cycles
- [Containers](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#containers): collecting components in a singleton container
- [Concurrency](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#concurrency): the `@synchronized` and `@threadsafe` decorators and their limitations
- [Oneshot](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#oneshot): `@oneshot` and `OneshotLevel`, running a function once globally, per class or per instance
- [Collector](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#collector): importing a package's modules to run their decorators
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): changes per release, including what 0.3.0 changes for 0.2.0 users
- [smalldi/__init__.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/__init__.py): `Injector`, its decorators, `get_instance`, the module-level shorthands and the deprecated `singletons_available`
- [smalldi/_singleton.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_singleton.py): `LazySingleton`, delegation to an override, freezing, `SingletonFrozenError`
- [smalldi/_interfaces.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_interfaces.py): interface bindings to implementations and overrides
- [smalldi/context.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/context.py): `InjectionContext`, `InjectionSubcontextType`, `InjectionContextManager`, `InjectionContextOverride` and its deprecated alias `InjectionContextSingletonOverride`
- [smalldi/_context/__init__.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_context/__init__.py): `InjectionContextRegistry`, the per-slice current context and the `ResourceWarning` for contexts left open
- [smalldi/_context/tree.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_context/tree.py): `ContextTree`, the per-slice context stacks
- [smalldi/thread.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/thread.py): `ContextAwareThread`
- [smalldi/annotation.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/annotation.py): the `Provide[T]` and `ImplementationOf[I]` annotations
- [smalldi/asynchronous.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/asynchronous.py): the coroutine-function wrapper behind `@Injector.inject` on `async def`
- [smalldi/container.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/container.py): `Container` and `ComponentRegistration`
- [smalldi/collector.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/collector.py): `Collector.collect_from_package`
- [smalldi/concurrency.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/concurrency.py): `@synchronized`, `@threadsafe` and the `mutex` helper
- [smalldi/decorator.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/decorator.py): `staticclass`, `oneshot` and `OneshotLevel`
- [smalldi/atomic.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/atomic.py): `AtomicSet`
- [smalldi/wrappers.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/wrappers.py): compatibility alias of `smalldi.decorator`
- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/pyproject.toml): package metadata, `requires-python` and the empty dependency list

- [test_injector_concurrency.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/tests/test_injector_concurrency.py): specification of threading behaviour, including the skipped cross-thread cycle case
